title: Build the Quote Request Assistant Premium Blueprint (private preview)
objective:
Build the Premium Blueprint described in agent-specs/quote-request-assistant.json. Read that spec, agents/standards.md, and AGENTS.md first.
Create the public guided demo at /blueprints/quote-request-assistant and the signed-in Premium kit at /blueprints/quote-request-assistant/kit.
Kit contents: Quote Request Setup Checklist; Scope Extraction Prompt; Fit Review Prompt; Qualification Rules Worksheet; Quote Tracker Template; Reply Review Checklist; Fictional Sample Requests; Data and Safety Guidance.
Follow every entry in the spec's constraints list.
Do not commit, push, merge, deploy, or publish.
acceptance_criteria: GET /blueprints/quote-request-assistant without a session renders a page whose h1 is 'Quote Request Assistant', with a visible 'Private preview' label.
The guided demo page's HTML contains a robots meta tag whose content includes 'noindex' and 'nofollow'.
The guided demo page shows the fictional data notice text exactly as specified in guided_demo.fictional_data_notice, above the first demo step.

The guided demo is a six-step stepper. It shows the text 'Step N of 6', a 'Next step' button (absent or disabled on step 6), and a 'Previous step' button (absent or disabled on step 1). Each step has a visible heading.

Step 1 shows the request text 'Need our back deck redone, maybe 300 sq ft, composite if not crazy expensive. Hoping before July. We're in Riverside.', the requester 'Jordan Hale', the date '2026-05-12', and qualification rules containing 'Riverside', '150', 'deck replacement', 'railings', 'roofing', and 'new-home construction'.

Step 2 shows CONFIRMED text containing 'deck replacement', 'maybe 300 sq ft', 'Riverside', 'hoping before July', 'composite', and 'Jordan Hale'. It shows AI INTERPRETATION text containing 'if not crazy expensive' and 'requested window, not a booked start date'. It shows the text labels 'CONFIRMED', 'AI INTERPRETATION', and 'RECOMMENDED ACTION' as visible words, not as color or icon alone.

Step 3 shows the exact heading 'FIT: YES' and reason text containing 'Riverside', '150', and 'deck replacement'. It shows the exact sentences 'A roofing request in Mesa would be FIT NO (out of catalog; outside service area).' and 'A curved custom deck in Riverside that is not listed as a catalog item would be NEEDS YOUR CHECK, not FIT NO.'

Step 4 shows the CONFIRMED line with location = Riverside. Activating 'Check facts against the request' reveals three rows (location, size, work_type), each containing the text 'Matches', and the values Riverside, maybe 300 sq ft, and deck replacement.

Step 5 shows exactly two questions whose text contains 'condition of the existing deck' and 'railing replacement', a draft containing 'Jordan', 'Riverside', '300 sq ft', and 'before July', and the exact sentence 'Do not send this draft.' The draft contains no '$', no 'cost band', no 'markup', and no supplier name.

Step 6 shows tracker text 'QR-1001', '2026-05-12', 'Jordan Hale', 'Riverside', 'deck replacement', '300', 'composite', 'before July', 'YES', and 'needs pricing', the exact sentences 'You price it. You send it. The kit changes nothing.' and 'Do not send this draft.', and a link to /blueprints/quote-request-assistant/kit whose visible text says sign-in is required and the kit is a private preview.
Every requester name, location, size, date, fit label, question, and tracker field in the demo matches the guided_demo.sample_input rows and sample_output exactly.
Neither page contains the text 'checkout', 'buy now', 'purchase', 'Buy Premium', '/month', 'per month', or a price. Neither page contains a dollar amount.
Neither page contains a percentage, an hours-saved figure, or an ROI or savings claim.
The homepage (/) and the site header contain zero links whose href includes '/blueprints/quote-request-assistant', and /sitemap.xml does not contain '/blueprints/quote-request-assistant'.
GET /blueprints/quote-request-assistant/kit without a session redirects to /auth with the query parameter next=/blueprints/quote-request-assistant/kit.

Quote Request Assistant is registered in src/lib/blueprints.ts with id and productSlug 'quote-request-assistant', access 'premium', href '/blueprints/quote-request-assistant/kit', purchaseHref '/blueprints/quote-request-assistant', and badge PREMIUM. It is not added to PAID_PRODUCTS and has no Stripe price.

The kit page calls requireUser('/blueprints/quote-request-assistant/kit') from src/lib/auth.ts and hasActiveEntitlement(user.id, 'quote-request-assistant') from src/lib/payments/access.ts. It exports metadata with robots { index: false, follow: false }.

With an authenticated entitled session, the kit page renders h1 'Quote Request Assistant Premium Kit' and the exact label text 'Premium · Private preview'. Kit resource and interaction criteria below apply only to this entitled state.

With an authenticated session that has no Quote Request Assistant entitlement, the kit page renders h1 'Premium is locked', does not render kit content sections such as #setup-checklist, and does not show a Buy Premium button or a Stripe price.

The kit page shows 8 resource sections with headings matching the kit_contents titles, each with an element id equal to its kit_contents id. A table of contents at the top links to each section with an href of '#<id>'.

The Scope Extraction Prompt is shown in a <pre> element and contains these strings: 'CONFIRMED', 'AI INTERPRETATION', 'RECOMMENDED ACTION', 'Do not invent', 'Do not send', 'Do not price', 'Do not add a tracker row', 'maybe 300', 'Never put prices'.

The Fit Review Prompt is shown in a <pre> element and contains: 'Apply the qualification rules before any FIT label', 'FIT YES', 'FIT NO', 'NEEDS YOUR CHECK', 'Do not mark FIT NO', 'Do not send', 'Do not price', 'You price it'.

Each prompt has a 'Copy Prompt' button that writes the exact <pre> text to the clipboard and changes its label to 'Copied'. If the clipboard is unavailable, it shows a visible error telling the person to copy manually.

The Qualification Rules Worksheet has visible labels 'Service area', 'Minimum project size (sq ft)', 'Services offered', 'Work that is out of scope (one per line)', and 'Internal notes that must never appear in a draft', with defaults 'Riverside', '150', 'deck replacement (wood or composite); railings', 'roofing', and 'prices; cost bands; markups; supplier names', plus a 'Generate My Qualification Rules' button.

With the defaults, the generated rules block contains 'Service area: Riverside.', 'Minimum size: 150 sq ft.', 'Offered: deck replacement (wood or composite); railings.', 'Out of scope: roofing.', 'Never put prices, cost bands, markups, or supplier names in a draft.', 'Apply these rules before any FIT label.', 'If location is missing, write NEEDS YOUR CHECK. Do not assume the service area.', 'If work is close but not in the catalog, write NEEDS YOUR CHECK. Do not mark FIT NO.', and 'Do not send, price, or add a tracker row.' The block has a Copy button.
If the service-area field is empty or whitespace only, the worksheet shows the error 'Enter a service area.' and generates no rules block.
If the minimum-size field is empty or whitespace only, the worksheet shows the error 'Enter a minimum project size.' and generates no rules block.

When 'Work that is out of scope (one per line)' is empty, the generated rules block contains no 'Out of scope:' line. When it contains 'roofing' and 'new-home construction' on two lines, the block contains 'Out of scope: roofing; new-home construction.'

The Quote Tracker Template shows the columns request_id, received, requester, location, work_type, size_sq_ft, material, timeline, fit, open_questions, status. Its 'Copy CSV' button writes text whose first line is 'request_id,received,requester,location,work_type,size_sq_ft,material,timeline,fit,open_questions,status' and whose QR-1001 row contains '2026-05-12', 'Jordan Hale', 'Riverside', 'deck replacement', '300', 'YES', and 'needs pricing'.

The Reply Review Checklist shows 9 checkbox items with visible labels, a progress line 'Checked N of 9', and a 'Reset checklist' button that sets the count back to 0. Progress is not saved beyond the browser session.

The Fictional Sample Requests section is labelled 'Fictional' and its copied text includes the Jordan Hale request sentence from guided_demo.sample_input and a second request containing 'roof' and 'Mesa'.
The Setup Checklist and the Data and Safety Guidance sections each state that file upload support and data controls in ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini differ by plan, account, and admin settings.
The kit page says that worksheet entries and checklist progress stay in this browser session and are not saved to Atlas.
With an authenticated entitled session, /my-blueprints shows the Quote Request Assistant card as Unlocked with an Open Blueprint link to /blueprints/quote-request-assistant/kit.

With an authenticated session that has no Quote Request Assistant entitlement, /my-blueprints shows the Quote Request Assistant card as Locked with an Available to purchase link to /blueprints/quote-request-assistant and no link to the kit.

With an authenticated session, /my-blueprints still shows the free Daily Inbox Starter Kit with Open Starter Kit pointing at /blueprints/daily-inbox-briefing/starter-kit. AI Collections Assistant entitlement, Buy Premium, and checkout behavior are unchanged. Security Readiness Action Pack and Google Ads Performance Coach entitlement and locked or unlocked card behavior are unchanged.

At a 393px-wide viewport, neither page scrolls horizontally (document scrollWidth minus clientWidth is 1px or less) on any demo step or kit section. Tables either wrap or scroll inside their own container.

Every interactive control on both pages can be reached with Tab and activated with Enter or Space, and shows a visible focus ring. After 'Next step' or 'Previous step', focus moves to the new step's heading.
Loading both pages produces no unexpected browser console errors or page errors, as judged by the e2e/support/fixtures.ts console filter.

Product implementation files live under app/blueprints/quote-request-assistant/, components/premium/quote-request-assistant/, and src/lib/premium/quote-request-assistant/. The Blueprint registry entry lives in src/lib/blueprints.ts. e2e/quote-request-assistant/authenticated.spec.ts is the protected acceptance test and must not be weakened, skipped, rewritten, or have assertions removed.

Authenticated QA uses the repository's automatic Playwright session refresh. If the session cannot be refreshed, QA stops with AUTH_SESSION_REFRESH_REQUIRED and that failure is not treated as a product defect.
The guided demo at /blueprints/quote-request-assistant renders without sign-in on desktop and a phone-sized viewport, uses only fictional data, and says so.
The kit at /blueprints/quote-request-assistant/kit requires sign-in, is labelled Premium · Private preview, and shows no price, checkout, or purchase claim.
Both pages set robots noindex and are not linked from the homepage, header, or sitemap.
Confirmed facts, AI interpretation, and recommended actions are labelled separately, and every external action stays with the person.
The Daily Inbox Briefing, its Starter Kit, and its tests are unchanged.
